summary.text: Ray Jeffers is a Democratic state representative from North Carolina House District 2 who has served since January 1, 2023, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
The General Assembly lists his occupation as farmer and non-profit administration, and his district as Durham and Person counties.

paragraphs.text: Jeffers attended Person County Schools, then Piedmont Community College and North Carolina Agricultural and Technical State University, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia also lists his profession as Person County commissioner.
Jeffers succeeded Republican Larry Yarborough in House District 2.
He serves on the House Agriculture and Environment, Appropriations, Energy and Public Utilities, State and Local Government, and Wildlife Resources committees and on the Legislative Ethics Committee.
